wrapper_profiles.name: local-operator-wrapper
wrapper_profiles.purpose: Invoke the thin gate with explicit family ownership, persist retained artifacts, and stop immediately on non-allow decisions.
allowed_responsibilities: Pass the exact operation_family, selection_input_kind, and explicit artifact output paths into the thin gate.
Request delegated apply only for families that the thin gate already marks as delegated-apply-capable.
Persist the top-level gate result plus any downstream family-owned artifacts emitted by the chosen adapter.
forbidden_responsibilities: Do not infer operation family or blank issue/pr fields from prose-only context.
Do not bypass a non-allow gate decision by invoking family adapters directly.
Do not reinterpret family-specific warnings into a different top-level decision vocabulary.

wrapper_profiles.name: publish-time-automation-wrapper
wrapper_profiles.purpose: Wrap the thin gate at publish time without flattening PR create stages or family-owned mutation semantics.
allowed_responsibilities: Invoke the thin gate only after explicit source selection has already fixed the requested family and artifact roots.
Use thin-gate delegated apply only for issue-conclusion, issue-relationship, and pr-body-rewrite.
Stop on planning-only or rejected families such as pr-create-preflight and hand control back to the existing create-specific stage owner.
forbidden_responsibilities: Do not collapse branch materialization, remote publish, live PR publish, and post-merge follow-up into one atomic publish gate.
Do not treat the thin gate as a generic mutation bus for future families that do not yet have bounded adapters.
Do not synthesize post-apply success when the underlying family-specific verify surface has not run.

wrapper_profiles.name: ci-secondary-enforcement-wrapper
wrapper_profiles.purpose: Use the thin gate as a read-only or replay-audit contract surface for CI mirrors and retained artifact publication.
allowed_responsibilities: Re-run planning or retained-evidence validation against explicit artifacts and publish the resulting JSON outputs.
Surface non-allow decisions, missing artifacts, or incomplete-convergence findings as CI-visible failures.
Mirror retained thin-gate artifacts for traceability without mutating live GitHub state.
forbidden_responsibilities: Do not perform live delegated apply from CI by default.
Do not own family-specific post-apply verification rules; CI may only surface their retained results.
Do not widen CI checks into prose lint or non-contract quality review.

post_apply_verify_exposure.top_level_rule: The thin gate may expose only wrapper-safe verify summary fields; family-specific verify logic remains owned by the underlying adapter or downstream verifier.

required_meanings.not-run: No post-apply verify was required or no family-owned verify artifact exists yet.
required_meanings.converged: A family-owned post-apply verify artifact explicitly says the requested target set converged.
required_meanings.stop-incomplete-convergence: The delegated apply ran but the retained family-owned verify artifact shows incomplete convergence, new deterministic drift, or missing evidence.
required_meanings.stop-for-reconciliation: The retained family-owned verify artifact surfaced a live-versus-source conflict that requires operator resolution.

forbidden_top_level_behavior: Do not copy family-specific check rows, warning taxonomies, or prose diagnostics into a fake universal verify schema.
Do not mark convergence from apply success alone; a separate family-owned verify result is required whenever verify_required=true.
Do not let wrapper code reinterpret family-specific verify semantics into allow-apply or publish-success without an explicit retained verify artifact.

boundary_rules: Thin gate wrapping must stay orchestration-only: wrappers may choose when to invoke the gate, but they must not redefine family-owned stage boundaries.
Delegated apply remains family-scoped: only bounded adapters already behind the thin gate may run under wrapper control.
PR create remains split: wrappers may call the thin gate for issue-readiness and front-half preflight, but later create stages remain outside delegated thin-gate apply.
Post-apply verify remains family-owned: the thin gate may surface retained verify summaries, but it must not absorb the underlying verify logic into one generic contract.
